about_body:
Dr. Madeleine Chung owns and leads Austin Cosmetic & Implant Dentistry. The practice is built around implants, All-on-X and full-mouth rehabilitation, with smile makeovers alongside them.

These are the cases patients think hardest about before saying yes. The work here is planned carefully, explained plainly, and carried through from the first consultation to the finished result.

services.name: Dental implants
services.blurb: Single and multiple implants, planned around how the tooth needs to look and function.

services.name: All-on-X full arch
services.blurb: A fixed full-arch solution for patients replacing an entire upper or lower set of teeth.

services.name: Full-mouth rehabilitation
services.blurb: Rebuilding worn, damaged or failing teeth as one coordinated treatment plan.

services.name: Smile makeovers
services.blurb: Cosmetic work planned as a whole smile rather than one tooth at a time.
